snippet.title: Dawn of the Monsters - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The cataclysmic clash of kaiju has arrived in Dawn of the Monsters, a manga-inspired, side-scrolling, giant-monster beat-'em-up from 13AM Games and WayForward! Take control of four gargantuan guardians — Megadon, the living volcano; Ganira, the colossal crustacean; Aegis Prime, the superhuman warrior; and Tempest Galahad, the titanium titan — and face the Nephilim hordes in 35 missions of kaiju-crushing combat! Power up with DNA augments, obliterate foes with devastating Rage Attacks and brutal Executions, and team up with a friend for 2-player co-op action! Dawn of the Monsters is rated T for Teen and is available now on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Stadia, and PC! More info: https://wayforward.com/dawn-of-the-monsters/
